scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('./lib', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --build ../../configs/ts/references/tsconfig.playwright.json --force && pnpm exec playwright install chromium
scripts.build:runtime: cd ../.. && pnpm run build:ext-host && pnpm run build:worker-host
scripts.ui-tests: pnpm run build:runtime && pnpm run build && playwright test --config=./configs/playwright.config.ts
scripts.ui-tests-ci: pnpm run build:runtime && pnpm run build && playwright test --config=./configs/playwright.ci.config.ts
scripts.ui-tests-concurrent-smoke: pnpm run build:runtime && pnpm run build && pnpm run ui-tests-concurrent-smoke:run
scripts.ui-tests-headful: pnpm run build:runtime && pnpm run build && playwright test --config=./configs/playwright.headful.config.ts
scripts.ui-tests-report: pnpm run build && pnpm run ui-tests-report-generate && allure open allure-results/allure-report
